figurative_meaning_en: to become understandable or to suddenly realize something
example_sentences_in_bangla: হঠাৎ তার মাথায় এল যে সে ভুল করেছে।
বইটি পড়ার পর ধীরে ধীরে সবকিছু মাথায় আসতে শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: Suddenly, it dawned on him that he had made a mistake.
After reading the book, everything started to sink in gradually.
note: This idiom reflects everyday cognitive processes in Bengali speech, emphasizing mental clarity.
